SSC Stenographer Grade C & D Tier-I Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information :Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the Tier-I Admit Card for the post of Stenographer Grade C & D on the official website. This recruitment has been issued for 1170 posts. The online application process for SSC Stenographer Grade C & D Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 24 April 2026, to 15 May 2026. The Examination is going to conducted from 09 to 15 September 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for SSC Stenographer Grade C & D Tier-I Admit Card 2026, which are given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 24 April 2026
  • Last Date : 15 May 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 16 May 2026
  • Form Correction Date : 20-21 May 2026
  • Exam Date : 09 to 15 September 2026 Revised
  • Exam City Details : 31 August 2026
  • Admit Card : 06 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 0/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 0/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
